task_description: Build a modern, high-performance personal portfolio and brand hub website using Next.js 14, Tailwind CSS, and Framer Motion. Dark mode with neon yellow/green accent, inspired by landonorris.com. Includes Header, Hero, Stats, About, Shop, Esports, Race Calendar, and Footer sections with scroll animations and mobile responsiveness.

verification.summary: pnpm build completes successfully. Static page generation passes. All 8 components render. No unit tests needed for this static portfolio site.
